name: @kauro/data-plane
description: Kauro data plane: the platform's own bounded parsers of untrusted source files — the container inspector (hardened ZIP/XML reader, CSV dialect facts, worksheet inventory, scan parts) and the selection evaluator and preview reader, each run in an isolated child process under the Node permission model with network hooks — the attempt envelope of a processing attempt (AttemptScratchStore, FencedArtifactWriter, GenerationSourceReader); and, as the test-only subpaths @kauro/data-plane/testing and @kauro/data-plane/testing/worker-host, the labelled contract fakes of the malware scanner and worker host ports.
